description: Reads one public LinkedIn person profile by its profile ID (the part after /in/ in the profile URL) and returns name, headline, location, summary, url, followers_count and connections_count; counts are rounded as LinkedIn shows them. It does not read company pages or private data, and does not search for people (use google_search to find a profile URL). Required: profile_id.

profile_id.description: Public profile ID, the part after /in/ in a LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. "williamhgates" for https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates/. Not a full URL or a company page.

name: get_linkedin_profile
title: Get LinkedIn Profile
